name: @codycodeagent/codywork
description: CodyWork — a Vue workbench for policy-bound Codex development

scripts.build: pnpm run verify:core-version && pnpm --filter @codywork/web build && pnpm --filter @codywork/server build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @codywork/server exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @codywork/web exec vue-tsc --noEmit
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:web && pnpm run build
